cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. This dripping tap is our chance to replace the whole sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only needs a washer. I've bought one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Excellent. We'll fit it while the sink's out and replace that swollen worktop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The worktop runs under every cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll empty the kitchen. With the cupboards out, we can finally fix the layout.
